audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra appointed-times text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Sabbath, Passover/Unleavened Bread, firstfruits, Weeks, trumpet memorial, Day of Atonement, Booths, harvest justice, and sacred assembly rhythms.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: Appointed times of YHWH, which you shall proclaim as holy convocations—these are my appointed times.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘These are My appointed feasts, the feasts of the LORD that you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

original.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽי

verses.restored: Six days work shall be done, but on seventh day is Sabbath of Sabbath-rest, a holy convocation; no work you shall do. It is Sabbath to YHWH in all your dwellings.

familiar.text: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

modern.text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a day of sacred assembly. You must not do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD. Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:14–28; Numbers 28:16–25; Deuteronomy 16:1–8)

original.text: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ מִקְרָא קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ שַׁבָּ֥ת הִוא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: These are appointed times of YHWH, holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed time.

familiar.text: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

modern.text: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times.

original.text: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִקְרָאֵ֖י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בְּמוֹעֲדָֽם

verses.restored: In first month, on fourteenth of month between evenings, is Passover to YHWH.

familiar.text: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’s passover.

modern.text: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.

original.text: בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: On fifteenth day of this month is Festival of Unleavened Bread to YHWH; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

familiar.text: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

modern.text: On the fifteenth day of the same month begins the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD. For seven days you must eat unleavened bread.

original.text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַצּ֥וֹת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ

verses.restored: On first day you shall have holy convocation; no laborious work you shall do.

familiar.text: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

modern.text: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly; you are not to do any regular work.

original.text: בַּיּוֹם֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן מִקְרָא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: You shall bring near fire-offering to YHWH seven days; on seventh day is holy convocation; no laborious work you shall do.

familiar.text: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

modern.text: For seven days you are to present an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.’” The Feast of Firstfruits

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ מִקְרָא קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When you come into land that I give you and reap its harvest, you shall bring first sheaf of your harvest to priest.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.

original.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וּקְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת קְצִירָ֑הּ וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֶת עֹ֛מֶר רֵאשִׁ֥ית קְצִירְכֶ֖ם אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: He shall wave sheaf before YHWH for your acceptance; on day after Sabbath priest shall wave it.

familiar.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

modern.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

original.text: וְהֵנִ֧יף אֶת הָעֹ֛מֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם מִֽמָּחֳרַת֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת יְנִיפֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: On day you wave sheaf, you shall make a complete male lamb, son of a year, as burnt offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: On the day you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a year-old lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD,

original.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֕ם בְּי֥וֹם הֲנִֽיפְכֶ֖ם אֶת הָעֹ֑מֶר כֶּ֣בֶשׂ תָּמִ֧ים בֶּן שְׁנָת֛וֹ לְעֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Its grain offering shall be two-tenths fine flour mixed with oil, fire-offering to YHWH, soothing scent; its drink offering shall be wine, fourth of a hin.

familiar.text: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

modern.text: along with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil—an offering made by fire to the LORD, a pleasing aroma—and its drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.

original.text: וּמִנְחָתוֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֑חַ וְנִסְכֹּ֥ה יַ֖יִן רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין

verses.restored: Bread, roasted grain, and fresh grain you shall not eat until this very day, until you bring offering of your Divine; age-long statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

familiar.text: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

modern.text: You must not eat any bread or roasted or new grain until the very day you have brought this offering to your God. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live. The Feast of Weeks (Acts 2:1–13)

original.text: וְלֶחֶם֩ וְקָלִ֨י וְכַרְמֶ֜ל לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ עַד עֶ֨צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַ֚ד הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת קָרְבַּ֖ן אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall count for yourselves from day after Sabbath, from day you brought sheaf of wave offering, seven complete Sabbaths.

familiar.text: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

modern.text: From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, you are to count off seven full weeks.

original.text: וּסְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָכֶם֙ מִמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת מִיּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת עֹ֖מֶר הַתְּנוּפָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שַׁבָּת֖וֹת תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּהְיֶֽינָה

verses.restored: Until day after seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; then bring near new grain offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.

original.text: עַ֣ד מִֽמָּחֳרַ֤ת הַשַּׁבָּת֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ת תִּסְפְּר֖וּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֛ם מִנְחָ֥ה חֲדָשָׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: From your dwellings bring two loaves as wave offering, two-tenths fine flour; leavened they shall be baked, firstfruits to YHWH.

familiar.text: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.

modern.text: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.

original.text: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם תָּבִ֣יאּוּ לֶ֣חֶם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁ֚תַּיִם שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים סֹ֣לֶת תִּהְיֶ֔ינָה חָמֵ֖ץ תֵּאָפֶ֑ינָה בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: With bread bring seven complete male lambs, sons of a year, one bull from herd, and two rams; they shall be burnt offering to YHWH, with grain offering and drink offerings, fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם עַל הַלֶּ֗חֶם שִׁבְעַ֨ת כְּבָשִׂ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וּפַ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד וְאֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם יִהְי֤וּ עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָתָם֙ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: You shall make one male goat as sin/purification offering and two male lambs, sons of a year, as sacrifice of peace/well-being.

familiar.text: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

modern.text: You shall also prepare one male goat as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old as a peace offering.

original.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּ֑את וּשְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִֽים

verses.restored: Priest shall wave them with bread of firstfruits as wave offering before YHWH, with two lambs; holy they shall be to YHWH for priest.

familiar.text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

modern.text: The priest is to wave the lambs as a wave offering before the LORD, together with the bread of the firstfruits. The bread and the two lambs shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

original.text: וְהֵנִ֣יף הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֹתָ֡ם עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַבִּכּוּרִ֤ים תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁנֵ֖י כְּבָשִׂ֑ים קֹ֛דֶשׁ יִהְי֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: You shall proclaim on this very day a holy convocation for yourselves; no laborious work you shall do; age-long statute in all your dwellings throughout generations.

familiar.text: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

modern.text: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This is to be a permanent statute wherever you live for the generations to come.

original.text: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּעֶ֣צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם בְּכָל מוֹשְׁבֹ֥תֵיכֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: When you reap harvest of your land, you shall not finish edge of your field in reaping, and gleaning of your harvest you shall not gather; for poor and for sojourner you shall leave them. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

modern.text: When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap all the way to the edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the foreign resident. I am the LORD your God.’” The Feast of Trumpets (Numbers 29:1–6)

original.text: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶ֞ם אֶת קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֗ם לֹֽא תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְךָ֙ בְּקֻצְרֶ֔ךָ וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִירְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: The LORD also said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying: In seventh month, on first of month, there shall be Sabbath-rest for you, memorial by trumpet blast, holy convocation.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly announced by trumpet blasts.

original.text: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן זִכְר֥וֹן תְּרוּעָ֖ה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: No laborious work you shall do, and you shall bring near fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: You must not do any regular work, but you are to present an offering made by fire to the LORD.’” The Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:1–34; Numbers 29:7–11)

original.text: כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Again the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: But on tenth of this seventh month is Day of Atonement/Coverings; holy convocation it shall be for you, and you shall afflict/humble your souls/lives and bring near fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: “The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You shall hold a sacred assembly and humble yourselves, and present an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: אַ֡ךְ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ֩ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה י֧וֹם הַכִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: No work you shall do on this very day, for it is Day of Atonement/Coverings, to make atonement/covering for you before YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

modern.text: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.

original.text: וְכָל מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י י֤וֹם כִּפֻּרִים֙ ה֔וּא לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: For every soul/life who is not humbled on this very day shall be cut off from its people.

familiar.text: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

modern.text: If anyone does not humble himself on this day, he must be cut off from his people.

original.text: כִּ֤י כָל הַנֶּ֨פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא תְעֻנֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ

verses.restored: Every soul/life who does any work on this very day, that soul/life I will destroy from midst of its people.

familiar.text: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

modern.text: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.

original.text: וְכָל הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ כָּל מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּ֛י אֶת הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ

familiar.text: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

modern.text: You are not to do any work at all. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.

modern.text: For seven days you are to present an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day you are to hold a sacred assembly and present an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.

translation_notes: Moedim/appoined times are sacred rhythms proclaimed as holy convocations, not merely private observances.
Weekly Sabbath precedes annual festivals and frames time itself around cessation/rest.
Passover and Unleavened Bread preserve Exodus liberation memory.
Firstfruits and Weeks sanctify harvest before consumption and include leavened firstfruit bread.
Verse 22 interrupts festival ritual with field-edge justice: poor and sojourner must share harvest abundance.
Day of Atonement repeats soul-humbling and total rest; guard against self-hatred interpretations.
Booths culminates in rejoicing and embodied memory of wilderness dwelling after Egypt.
safety_note: Do not turn appointed times into legalistic status markers or shame those unable to observe them. The chapter joins sacred time to liberation memory, rest, harvest gratitude, communal joy, and material provision for poor and sojourner.
